verified: San Diego's city council voted Monday evening to terminate contracts with Flock and Ubicquia, per the San Diego Union-Tribune, and Flock carries an estimated $8.3 billion valuation, per Ars Technica.
unconfirmed: the effective date of the terminations, whether the cameras and streetlight sensors have already been switched off or will be removed, the vote count, and any termination costs — none of these details appear in the supplied reports.

verified: 据《圣地亚哥联合论坛报》报道、Ars Technica 转引，圣地亚哥市议会周一晚投票决定终止与 Flock 和 Ubicquia 的合同；报道称该市是终止 Flock 合同的最大城市之一。
unconfirmed: 合同终止的生效日期、设备是否立即停用或拆除、已采集数据的处置方式以及合同财务条款，来源均未说明。

titles.en: San Diego council ends Flock and Ubicquia surveillance contracts
titles.zh: 圣地亚哥市议会投票终止 Flock 与 Ubicquia 合同
